subject.title: fix(agents): cloud thinking models time out at 120s during reasoning (#80349) [AI-assisted]

question: Should this PR be allowed to proceed with source-level resolver proof only, or require a completed live Gemini thinking run after the conflict and call-site fix are addressed?
rationale: The patch changes a compatibility-sensitive timeout default for cloud thinking models, and the contributor's available proof does not yet show the reported live user path succeeding after the fix.

options.title: Require Live Proof After Refresh
options.body: Ask for a conflict-resolved PR plus redacted live Gemini embedded-run logs, terminal output, or a recording showing the roughly 125s timeout no longer occurs.

options.title: Accept Source-Level Proof
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the resolver and fake-timer proof plus the runtime tradeoff if live Google quota is unavailable.

options.title: Replace With Maintainer Patch
options.body: If the contributor cannot refresh the branch and provide proof, a maintainer-owned patch can carry the same narrow fix with local credentials for validation.

recommendation.title: Require Live Proof After Refresh
recommendation.body: Ask for a conflict-resolved PR plus redacted live Gemini embedded-run logs, terminal output, or a recording showing the roughly 125s timeout no longer occurs.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent adjacent timeout/runtime ownership and is the best available owner for the proof and compatibility tradeoff.
